question: ΔABC is a right - angle triangle at B. If tan A = {{5} over 12}, then sin A + sin B + sin C will be equal to:
solution:
**Given: **

tan A = {{5} over 12}

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7eec38e6a2dba94f22411eccc0c7ebe18f43e78781947f734eb6560f15903673.png] 

As we know tan = P/B and sin θ = P/H

So, H = √(P² + B²)

⇒ H = √(52 + 122)

⇒ H = √(25 + 144)

⇒ H = √169

⇒ H = 13

Now,

sin A + sin B + sin C 

= sin A + sin 90° + sin C

= {{5} over 13} + 1 + {{12} over 13}

⇒ {{5 + 13 +12} over 13}

⇒ {{30} over 13}

⇒ 2{{4} over 13}

**∴ The required answer is 2{{4} over 13}**.
